# Nuclear Winter plans as rewards

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_60_nukaknights-post-nuclear-winter-plaene-belohnung.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

With today's update (September 8th, 2021), NW has been switched off and many of the rewards have now moved to adventure mode in the form of blueprints.

**The blueprints cannot be traded.**

## TREASURE HUNTER REWARDS:

- 
 Plan: Laser gun blue camo paint
- 
 Plan: Small supply crate
- 
 Plan: Pink sprinkles power armor paints
- 
 Plan: Missile launcher Atom Cats paint

## GIFTS:

- 
 Plan: .44 blue camo paint
- 
 Plan: Vault 51 jumpsuit
- 
 Plan: Blue camo power armor paints

## EVENTS:

- 
 Plan: 10mm hot rod shark paint (Encryptid)
- 
 Plan: Centurion helmet (Colossal Problem)
- 
 Plan: Gladiator mask (Project Paradise)
- 
 Plan: Inferno mark 1 power armor paints (Project Paradise)
- 
 Plan: Inferno mark 2 power armor paints (Encryptid)
- 
 Plan: Inferno mark 3 power armor paints (Colossal Problem)
- 
 Plan: Large supply crate (Colossal Problem)
- 
 Plan: Laser gun hot rod flames paint (Colossal Problem)
- 
 Plan: Makeshift ronin helmet (Encryptid)
- 
 Plan: Minigun hot rod shark paint (Project Paradise)
- 
 Plan: Minigun Vault-Tec paint (Encryptid)
- 
 Plan: Missile launcher shi paint (Project Paradise)
- 
 Plan: Outcast power armor paints (Scorched Earth)

## MINERVA (IN GAME FROM 12/8/2021, SEE MINERVA POST):

-

- 
 Plan: Medium Supply Crate
-

- 
 Plan: Brotherhood of Steel minigun paint
